replay_verdict.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
replay_verdict.reason: Birth-pair conserved manual-launch shape predicts short held-out movement prefixes, but all original causes remain ambiguous without action or prebirth supply/route provenance. No full requested horizon and no ordinary combat result is scored.

decision_metrics.ownership_correctness: reported per tick only where exact owner fields are determinable; otherwise UNKNOWN
decision_metrics.remaining_units_error: reported through exact state signature comparisons; no summary without determinable states
decision_metrics.ETA_tick_error: UNKNOWN unless one-to-one visible force identity and ETA exist on both sides
decision_metrics.capture_result: event tags only; no terminal result inferred
decision_metrics.action_legality: birth-pair direct adjacency checks only; terminal path legality UNKNOWN

root_acceptance.case_dependence: 13 selected windows from four recordings / seven source towers / four foreign owners; neither IID draws nor 56 independent gameplay events
root_acceptance.scored_class_count_scope: Confirmed classifications in 56 successfully scored prefix ticks only; unknown/unscored later ticks are not included and remain separately reported.

fixed_method.temporal_firewall: Per case, parse no world sequence later than T_birth; use the first reliable visible matching NEW_TRACK/progress-zero observation within the audited birth tick.
fixed_method.prebirth_baseline: First retained observation in the immediately previous distinct world tick; same document/match/player scope and complete coverage required.
fixed_method.source_conservation: Report raw pre-minus-birth vector and local deterministic no-action source counterfactual; consistency does not identify the actor or exclude unmodeled supply-line dispatch.
fixed_method.supply_rule: Only explicit prebirth fields/observations count; missing supply-line/route/relay values stay UNKNOWN.
fixed_method.prior_periodicity: Only complete same-scope consecutive first-per-tick births strictly before current T; require at least two prior intervals exactly equal before claiming periodicity.
fixed_method.external_action_threshold: Case-linked durable ACTION_INTENT/UI_ACTION_RESULT plus unique pair birth and vector consistency; none retained for these cases.
fixed_method.internal_supply_threshold: Known prebirth supply-line/relay input plus prior repeated equal intervals and vector-consistent event; none meets this threshold.
fixed_method.inbound_arrival: Only immediate prebirth inbound force rows, progress and observer-derived ETA versus report tick duration; derived ETA is not server authority.
fixed_method.production_overflow: Compute source local phase/production and overflow opportunity at T; compare local no-action inventory effects. This does not prove supply-line absence.

source_scope.temporal_access: Full-file SHA-256 is recorded for provenance; each case parser stops at its first reliable birth observation in T_birth and does not parse a later tick.

Old snapshots do not retain source supply-line/route/relay values; current force segments expose only the current leg.
